name: Stolen Enchanting Supplies

angles.text: Keeping the supply route to the Tower of Azora secure helps Stormwind's frontline mages stay equipped against threats in Elwynn Forest and beyond.
The Tower of Azora's arcane research depends on delicate materials. Recovered enchanting reagents matter to mages studying under Master Theocritus.
As a gnome apprentice, you may find yourself doing menial work for human archmages. A mistake can bring humiliating chore duty.

faq.answer: Blixie Fitzwink asks for help near the Tower of Azora. She assists Master Theocritus and was ambushed by gnolls while carrying supplies back from a local trading post.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Stolen Enchanting Supplies?

faq.answer: Master Theocritus is a senior human wizard who lives at the Tower of Azora in eastern Elwynn Forest. He oversees arcane investigations in the region and relies on assistants to bring him enchanting reagents and research materials.
The gnolls took enchanting reagents gathered at a trading post for Master Theocritus's arcane work. The ambush scattered the cargo, and the items ended up in gnoll camps around Stone Cairn Lake.
faq.q: What supplies were taken by the gnolls?

faq.answer: Stone Cairn Lake lies in eastern Elwynn Forest, north of the Tower of Azora. Gnoll packs camp along its shores and on surrounding islands, threatening travelers on nearby roads.
faq.q: Where did the gnolls take the supplies?

faq.answer: Blixie fears Master Theocritus will give her weeks of cleaning duty after his polymorph experiments. Apprentices at the tower face mundane or messy chores when errands or magical duties go wrong.
faq.q: Why is Blixie Fitzwink worried about losing the package?

aliases: why are gnolls near tower of azora
faq.answer: Gnoll packs prowl eastern Elwynn Forest, with hostile camps around Stone Cairn Lake and raids on nearby roads. They disrupt trade and ambush travelers moving between settlements and arcane outposts.
faq.q: Why are gnolls attacking travelers in eastern Elwynn?

sections.body: Blixie Fitzwink was carrying supplies from a trading post to the Tower of Azora when gnolls ambushed her on the road. She fled, leaving the cargo scattered among their camps along Stone Cairn Lake. The valuable reagents were meant for Master Theocritus, whom Blixie assists. Now she asks travelers to recover them, fearing weeks of cleanup duty after her arcane polymorph experiments.
sections.title: An Ambush on the Road

sections.body: Master Theocritus conducts sensitive magical research at the Tower of Azora in eastern Elwynn Forest. His work depends on delicate reagents brought from local trading posts. Gnoll packs around Stone Cairn Lake have grown bolder, making the route dangerous. The lost supplies could interrupt his studies, while their return may spare his beleaguered assistant further trouble.
sections.title: Arcane Errands and Local Hazards

summary: Near the Tower of Azora, Blixie Fitzwink has lost the supplies she was carrying after a gnoll ambush. The enchanting reagents are scattered among camps around Stone Cairn Lake. Their return could spare her weeks of chore duty and keep Master Theocritus's arcane studies supplied.
